title: Assistant
subtitle: Explore your family budget and prepare changes. You choose what to apply.
deleteHint: The conversation and its proposals will be deleted. Applied financial changes will remain.
emptyHint: I can explore spending, explain the forecast and propose changes. Finances and settings change only after you approve them.
error: Could not receive a response. Check your connection and retry.
noPermission: You do not have permission to apply this item.
expiredHint: Proposals expire after 7 days. If the original data changes, ask for a new proposal.

starters.spending: Where is our money going this month?

admin.title: AI assistant
admin.description: One provider per installation. Check the connection and tool calling first.
admin.keyStored: Key saved. Leave blank to keep it.
admin.manualModel: Choose from the list or enter a model manually.
admin.limit: Monthly token limit per household (0 = unlimited)
admin.env: Managed through ENV. Fields are read-only.
admin.quotaHint: Up to {tokens} tokens are reserved only while a turn runs. Completion uses provider usage or an estimate of sent context and received output. On the next request, abandoned reservations are released 10 minutes after the turn lease expires.

consent.title: AI for your household
consent.description: Only the household owner can enable the assistant.
consent.unavailable: The system administrator has not enabled or verified a provider yet.
consent.local: Data stays on your server (as configured by the administrator).
consent.aggregatesHint: Shares category/month totals, accounts and balances, recurring schedules, budgets, goals, loans and forecasts. Transaction descriptions and notes are excluded. Entity names are visible to the model.
consent.detailedHint: Also shares transaction titles, descriptions and counterparties in limited search results.
consent.messages: The provider also receives your messages and conversation history. Do not send secrets. Conversations are stored in the application database; you can delete your own.
consent.agree: I consent to sharing the listed data with this provider.
consent.enabled: Enable the assistant for this household
consent.renew: The provider changed. Please renew consent.

minorUnits: {value} minor units in the transaction currency

review.title: Recommendations
review.hint: AI proposes changes. You decide what to apply.
review.author: AI budget review
review.manualLimit: Up to {count} manual reviews per household per day. Uses the shared AI quota.
review.emptyHint: Run a review or enable a schedule. Rejected directions of change will not be suggested again.
review.expiredHint: This recommendation expired or was replaced by a new review.
review.settingsHint: Time zone: {timezone}. After downtime, one review catches up for the current week or month; days 29–31 are clamped to the last day of shorter months.
review.channelsHint: Allowed household channels. Delivery respects each member’s personal preferences and quiet hours.
review.enableHint: First confirm household AI consent above. Then choose weekly or monthly reviews.
review.emailHint: E-mail requires configured SMTP and uses your profile address. It is off by default.
review.widgetEmpty: No new recommendations yet. Run a review or set up a schedule.

runStatus.failed: failed — a manual review is available
runStatus.interrupted: interrupted — a manual review is available

review.lifetimeHint: Proposals remain available for 7 days or until the next review. Selected items are checked again before applying.
review.staleBudget: Outdated: the “{label}” limit or its category has changed.
review.staleItem: Outdated: “{label}” or its referenced entities have changed.
review.dataChanged: Data has changed since the review
